content.thinking: /tmp isn't writable? Interesting — exit=1 with no stderr shown? The bash tool may restrict /tmp. Let me use /workspace/tmp instead (there's a tmp dir there).

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && mkdir -p tmp/out && python3 submission/ipv6_replay.py plan examples/manifest.json > tmp/out/plan.json; echo "exit=$?"; python3 -c "
import json
a=json.load(open('tmp/out/plan.json')); b=json.load(open('examples/expected-plan.json'))
print('plan match:', a==b)
"
python3 submission/ipv6_replay.py replay examples/manifest.json examples/responses.jsonl > tmp/out/rep.json; echo "exit=$?"; python3 -c "
import json,pprint
a=json.load(open('tmp/out/rep.json')); b=json.load(open('examples/expected-replay.json'))
print('replay match:', a==b)
if a!=b:
  for k in b:
    if a.get(k)!=b[k]: print('DIFF',k); pprint.pprint(b[k]); pprint.pprint(a.get(k))
"
